**Daily Devotional**

**June 5**

*3 How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him; 4 God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will? (Hebrews 2:3-4 KJV)*

Jesus brought us the New Covenant, which is much better than the Old Covenant that was given through Moses (Hebrews 8:12). How anyone could prefer living under the Law brought in by the Old Covenant instead of the Grace of God brought in by Jesus and the New Covenant is hard to understand, as the keeping of the Law put all the burden upon us, whereas the Grace given us by God gives us justification without our keeping the Law (Romans 3:21).

In the early Church the teaching of God’s Word was always followed by healings and miracles, and made the preaching powerful by such signs (Mark 16:20). Why the Church now thinks that we don’t need the signs and wonders following the preaching of the Word, I don’t understand. Even Jesus used the miracles of healing and deliverance to confirm His Words, so it is arrogant for us to think we don’t need it now. If preachers would use the Gifts of the Spirit to draw people to the services, then we would have crowds like Jesus had at His services (Matthew 14:21). Maybe we should try and be more relevant to the world we are living in, and people would see the Church as helping them in this life, and not just in eternity (John 10:10). Thank God for Jesus!
